title: S5 Pulse Target independent acceptance

gameplay.core_loop: Move continuously with the arrow keys and press Space while centered inside the fixed target zone.
invariants: Space outside the target zone does not change score or phase.
A successful target lock produces score 1 and Won.
All gameplay state is stable after Won.

development_plan: Run every automated test from its own fresh page.
Use goal-based movement checks instead of relying on one exact key-hold duration.
Keep this acceptance plan outside all generation, planning and repair messages.
Preserve the frozen plan and original failures without changing expected values after generation.

state_contract.playerX: Actual horizontal center of the player in canvas coordinates.
state_contract.score: Actual score, initially 0 and exactly 1 after winning.
state_contract.phase: Exact current phase: Playing or Won.

requirements.text: The initial player position, score and phase are correct.
Arrow keys produce continuous horizontal movement.
Movement is clamped at both canvas boundaries.
Space outside the target zone is a no-op.
The target is reachable and a successful lock wins.
Movement and Space are ignored and state remains stable after Won.
Restart from Won restores the exact initial state.
The player, target, instructions and status are clearly visible.

evidence.spec_quote: The player marker starts centered at playerX=30 ... score=0 and phase Playing.
evidence.expected_basis: A fresh page reports playerX 30, score 0 and Playing, with score and phase matching the DOM.

tests.description: Holding ArrowRight moves the player continuously

evidence.spec_quote: The player marker ... may move while ArrowLeft or ArrowRight is held.
evidence.expected_basis: Holding ArrowRight from playerX 30 must produce a greater position while remaining in Playing.

tests.description: Both horizontal boundaries clamp the player center

evidence.spec_quote: Movement ... clamps the player's center to the inclusive range 10 through 350.
evidence.expected_basis: Long movement toward each edge reaches but never crosses 10 and 350.

tests.description: Space outside the target is a no-op

evidence.spec_quote: Pressing Space outside the zone has no effect.
evidence.expected_basis: At the initial playerX 30, Space leaves playerX 30, score 0 and Playing.

tests.description: The fixed target is reachable and Space wins

evidence.spec_quote: Pressing Space wins only when the player's center is inside that inclusive target zone ... score to 1 and phase to Won.
evidence.expected_basis: ArrowRight can reach playerX at least 175, which is inside 170 through 190; Space then produces score 1 and Won.

tests.description: Won state ignores input and remains stable

evidence.spec_quote: After Won, movement and Space have no effect and the state remains stable.
evidence.expected_basis: After a successful lock, further ArrowRight and Space input leave playerX unchanged, score 1 and Won; sampling confirms short-window stability.

tests.description: Restart from Won restores the exact initial state

evidence.spec_quote: #restart always restores exactly playerX=30, score=0 and phase Playing without reloading the page.
evidence.expected_basis: After a reachable win, clicking Restart returns all state fields and visible score/phase to their initial values.

manual_checks.instruction: On desktop and a narrow viewport, confirm the 360 by 220 canvas, player and target are visibly distinct; instructions, score, phase and Restart remain readable without overlap.
